Be like the sun, with its burning passion, and you shall survive.
May the sun itself guide your focus and light the way.
As you walk, you leave fire and arrows in your wake.
Although the shadows may try to put you down, your light shines on and surrounds you.
Even when all has turned to darkness, you stay strong, and fight with your almighty fury.
In total darkness, you stand firm, bravely.
The night does not scare you---you embrace it, in fact. For even the moon itself casts rays of dim light.
May you not cast a shadow as you sneak around your foes.
May you step carefully with the moon's grace.
The balance of light and darkness must always be kept..
You must keep the universe balanced..
For balance keeps the universe together.
With every beginning, there must be an end..
You bring an end to those writhing in wickedness...
Before there is an ending, there must be a beginning.
You begin to bring an age of hope and peace...
"You cannot judge me; I am Justice itself! We were meant for more than this, to protect the innocent!"
"All I am guilty of, Imperius, is bringing justice, while you hide cowering behind your throne!"
"Forevermore, we shall stand together, angels and men, in the light of this glorious new dawn."
You are filled with Holy anger.
